question: As per Census of India 2011, identify the state in which the population density was recorded more than 100 people / sq.km.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **As per the Census of India 2011**, Rajasthan had a population density of 200 people per square kilometer, which is more than 100 people per square kilometer.
 
• Rajasthan, **despite being the largest state in India by area, has a relatively low population density compared to other densely populated states but exceeds the 100 people/sq. km benchmark.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Population Density of the **Other States (2011 Census)**:
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh:** 17 people per sq. km, the lowest in India due to its large area and sparse population.
 
• **Mizoram:** 52 people per sq. km, reflecting its hilly terrain and smaller population.
 
• **Sikkim:** 86 people per sq. km, a sparsely populated Himalayan state.

Census 2011__

 
• The Indian Census is the most credible source of information on Demography (Population characteristics), Economic Activity, Literacy and Education, Housing Household Amenities, Urbanisation, Fertility and Mortality, etc. 
 
• Census 2011 was the 15th National Census of the Country.
 
• Census was introduced in India during the era of Lord Mayo in the year 1872. It came into force in 1881.
 
• This census was conducted under the guidance of Mr. C. Chandramouli.
 
• The slogan of census 2011 was ‘Our Census, Our future’.
 
• The population of the nation as per the provisional figures of Census 2011 was 1210.19 million of which 623.7 million (51.54%) were males and 586.46 million (48.46%) were females. Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in India its population is more than the population of Brazil.
